name: Gori, no ne szhigaj
source:
The beginning of another shift.
It seems to be his sixth one already, if memory serves right. At times, it even feels like everything in this place is too repetitive. But such thoughts quickly fade, because Semyon has already set a goal and won’t rest until he achieves it.

From shift to shift, he tries to get closer to one of the girls: Miku, Lena, Slavya, Ulyana, and Alisa. Five cycles have already passed, and still no success.
The loop resets, but now Semyon is confident that things will work out. He knows this place well.

But what if familiar events start unfolding differently? Pioneers begin disappearing, disrupting the usual life of the camp...
Should he try to understand what’s happening, or continue pursuing his goal - to spend the rest of the shift with one of the girls?
